notes: TBox revision (migrated 2026-11-11 to the new layout: three propositional queries, three determinate derived queries, no worlds or indeterminate queries). No real exceptions known: Standard ML, Caml, OCaml, F#, Alice ML and the other ML dialects are statically typed with type inference. Kept although the model audit was mixed: the original fact (direct and paraphrase) was missed by one model only (Mistral), which Rule 6 allows; the Spanish question was missed by three models answering "Dinámico", most likely reading "familia ML" as machine learning, so it now spells out "ML (Meta Language)"; the conjunction (side fact Python is dynamically typed, which matches the new answer and invited a yes) now uses an unrelated true side fact (Java is object-oriented). The F# queries and checks went with the indeterminate queries. The derived queries name made-up members (Tamarin, Corvid, Halcyon) in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops); the third is an application (a project that allows only statically typed languages). The near query asks Java, whose answer (static) differs from the new answer. Review fix: every English prompt now spells out 'ML (Meta Language)' because audit misses on the derived originals came from reading 'ML' as machine learning; re-audit pending.
